data: What is the approximate value of the orange line at 4 k-step look-ahead?

The orange line represents the WMT17 EN-DE Transformer model, and the green line represents the WMT17 EN-DE Transformer model with Auxiliary EOS loss. The y-axis shows the Length Differences per Sentence. At 4 k-step look-ahead, the orange line appears to be around -3.2.
